title: 新年会の場面
subject_en: New-year party scenes for office workers in a flat style: each a small complete scene or object with simple-faced adults, warm colours Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 乾杯・幹事の挨拶・ビンゴ・料理の大皿など、新年会の場面12点の素材です。社内の案内や幹事の連絡資料に使えます。
items: three colleagues raising beer glasses together at a table
a man standing to give a short speech holding a glass
a person drawing a numbered ball from a bingo cage, others holding cards
a large platter of sashimi and fried food on a table
two colleagues looking at new-year postcards together
a banquet room with a pine and bamboo decoration and round tables
a tatami banquet room with low tables and cushions, seated people from behind
a set of wrapped prizes and a gift box on a table
a restaurant staff member carrying a tray of dishes
a group of colleagues walking together at night with a lantern sign
a bowl of ochazuke rice with tea poured over
a person with a calculator and cash envelope counting money at a table
